title: Crushed potatoes with leeks and soft eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, leeks, eggs, butter, wholegrain mustard, cheddar and thyme are all plain home-kitchen foods.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a saucepan, a frying pan, a fork and a grater, with simple boiling and softening.

works.reason: Simmering 2cm chunks for 12 minutes with the eggs in for the last 7 gives tender potatoes and soft-set yolks, and 750g of potatoes with 4 eggs suits four people at breakfast.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes of chopping, slicing, grating and egg peeling, plus a 12 minute simmer, is believable and fits the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the thyme, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted is added.

seasonal_feel.reason: Crushed potatoes with January leeks make a warming winter plate, with the potatoes clearly at its centre.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English that a beginner can follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potatoes, leeks, eggs and cheese make a filling, balanced savoury breakfast a family would make again.
